title: Round 36: declaration rewrites from authoritative IDLs (R33-5 follow-up)
rule: graphite-core/src/state_diff.rs DeclaredEffects::parse / covers_by_name / debit_names_no_account (R33-5): only a line that names accounts.<x> declares that account's debit for the signer judgements; a line naming no account is unreadable for a signer's loss.
method: The census was reproduced in Python with a line-for-line port of DeclaredEffects::parse and effect_words, over SEED_MANIFESTS and intent_grants.rs GRANTS: HEAD gives (3541, 1820, 1802, 1802, 18, 27), as pinned.

Each rewrite names only accounts present in every layout of its instruction (exact spelling); each new line was parsed alone and must name an account for every effect it declares (no unscoped line), and the whole declaration must keep a named debit.

Roles follow the grammar: an account after 'from' takes the debit, after 'to'/'into' only the credit, otherwise every effect of the line. Signer-owned accounts are named as debited only where the IDL says the user's value leaves them; user destinations are credit-only; fee/referral/host accounts are credit-only.
Where an IDL file exists, the manifest layout was checked slot by slot against it (as tests/r30_declared_effects_census.rs does for REWRITTEN).

Also checked: the swap intent's L5 vocabulary and L7 FakeSwap ('credit'/'output') still match; no line carries the structural trigger words signer/approve/delegate/assign; no line uses a word that would declare an unintended effect (owner -> authority, mint -> mint, open/init -> create, fee/pay -> debit).

Lines that declare nothing (the generated 'modifies writable accounts: ...' lines and the bare identifiers in raydium-amm-v4) were kept, so no declaration got shorter (the drainer heuristic counts lines).

left_unchanged.DF1ow4tspfHX9JwWJsAb9epbkA8hmpSEAtxXy1V2: manifested (swap-orchestrator-df1ow4.json), only an unscoped line. The IDL's fixed accounts are token_program, associated_token_program, system_program, user_token_authority (signer), event_authority, program: the user's source and destination token accounts are remaining accounts addressed by SwapParams.actions. No layout account holds the user's value, so no accounts.<name> can be written; left unchanged (honest DFlow swaps stay refused under R33-5).

residuals: Pump AMM buy/sell: the IDL documents account creation only for buy_exact_quote_in, so buy declares none; a first buy that pays rent for user_volume_accumulator or a fee ATA is still a W19 refusal.
Stake Pool and Raydium AMM v4 have no IDL file in the repository; their rewrites rest on the manifest layout names (and, for Stake Pool, intent_grants.rs STAKE_POOL_SOURCE). Confidence medium.
Marinade liquidUnstake: no mSOL burn is declared because the IDL does not say the supply changes.

Remaining accounts (CLMM reward vaults, Jupiter venue accounts, DLMM bin arrays) cannot be named; a signer-owned one that ends lower is UndeclaredTokenDebit, now with no relaxation (before: SignerTokenDebitUnderUnscopedDebit, relaxable by GRAPHITE_ALLOW_UNREADABLE_VALUE_DECLARATIONS).

Side effect on L7 heuristics: detect_hidden_transfer's threshold is 4 x the distinct accounts.<name> references (min 12), so naming accounts raises it for the non-DEX programs rewritten here (Pump AMM, DBC, Stake Pool, Marinade). It only applies when the account list does not match the manifest layout.
